instructions: Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

groups.instructions:
Questions 1-2 refer to Passage A13 - The Concrete That Mends Its Own Cracks

Answer the questions below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answers in boxes 1-2 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: In the specimens carrying the lower dose of capsules, how long after the damage did water absorption drop sharply?
items.evidence: In specimens holding the lower dose, absorption began to slow about a day after damage, roughly the time the epoxy needs to set, and then fell sharply at four days.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says that in the lower-dose specimens absorption began to slow about a day after damage and then fell sharply at four days; the answer is therefore 'four days'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Paket grup yapisina gecirildi; kalem A01 (Kandula, fil) yerine A13'e tasindi. A13'un notlarinda kisa cevap icin ayrilan iki paragraftan biri D; bu kalem D/3'e capali. Cevap calismanin kendi olcum egrisinden gelen bir gun degeri, disaridan turetilemez.

items.prompt: What is the cementation medium used in the laboratory built around?
items.evidence: In the laboratory the reaction is driven by a cementation medium built around 0.5 molar urea, which supplies the raw material the organisms consume.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the laboratory reaction is driven by a cementation medium built around 0.5 molar urea; the answer must include the concentration as well as the substance, so it is '0.5 molar urea'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A02 (Napoli Korfezi ahtapotlari) yerine A13/F'ye tasindi; F, pasajin notlarinda kisa cevap icin ayrilan ikinci paragraf. Kok bilerek 'neyin uzerine kurulu' diye soruyor: yalniz 'urea' diyen (alan bilgisiyle tahmin eden) cozucu kabul edilmiyor, derisim de gerekiyor. Ayni paragraftaki tur adi (Sporosarcina pasteurii) genel kulturden bilinebilecegi icin cevap olarak kullanilmadi.

groups.instructions:
Question 3 refers to Passage A14 - The Data That Never Arrived

Answer the question below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answer in box 3 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: Within how long a publication period had all the papers chosen for the study appeared?
items.evidence: They selected forty-nine papers published within a single six-month period in two leading psychology journals, both of which obliged their authors to make research material available to other scholars.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the team selected papers published within a single six-month period in two journals; the answer is therefore 'six months'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A03 (laboratuvar deneylerinin suresi) yerine A14'e tasindi. A14'un notlari serbest paragraf adi vermiyor; yontem paragrafi B secildi, cunku sayi yogun C-H paragraflari cumle tamamlama / coktan secmeli / YES-NO-NOT GIVEN paketlerinin dogal hedefi. 🔴 Diger paketler B paragrafina dokunmamali.

groups.instructions:
Question 4 refers to Passage A15 - Teaching a Plant to Defend Itself Faster

Answer the question below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answer in box 4 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: How many millilitres of clean air entered each sealed chamber every minute?
items.evidence: Clean air entered at seven hundred millilitres a minute and was drawn out at six hundred, so that the small imbalance kept room air from seeping in.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says clean air entered the chamber at seven hundred millilitres a minute while six hundred was drawn out; since the question asks about the air entering, the answer is '700'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A04 (JWST poz sayisi, genel kultur isaretli) yerine A15/E'ye tasindi; E, pasajin ucucu toplama yontemini anlatan ve baska hicbir sorunun dokunmayacagi paragraf. Kok 'giren' akisi soruyor, cunku ayni cumlede cikan akis (600) rakip deger olarak duruyor; ikisinin de degeri yalniz bu duzenege ozgu.

groups.instructions:
Question 5 refers to Passage A16 - What Changes When the Ground Gets Harder

Answer the question below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answer in box 5 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: How long was the laboratory runway that the runners crossed?
items.evidence: The runway was fifteen metres long and one metre wide.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the runway was fifteen metres long and one metre wide; since the question asks about its length, the answer is 'fifteen metres'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A05 (yanmis tahil yasi) yerine A16'ya tasindi. A16'nin notlari serbest paragraf adi vermiyor; olcum duzenegini anlatan D secildi, cunku not tamamlamanin uc kalemi B paragrafinin uc zemin degerine (0.290 / 0.320 / 0.420) dogal olarak oturuyor. 🔴 Diger paketler D paragrafina dokunmamali.

groups.instructions:
Question 6 refers to Passage A17 - What Settles First on a Surface Under Water

Answer the question below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answer in box 6 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: In milligrams per litre, what was the highest level of dissolved oxygen recorded while the panels were in the water?
items.evidence: Dissolved oxygen ranged from 5.8 to 6.9 milligrams per litre, while nitrate, nitrite and phosphate were all present in small and fairly steady quantities.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says dissolved oxygen ranged from 5.8 to 6.9 milligrams per litre; the top of that range is the highest level recorded, so the answer is '6.9'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A06 (sirketin calistigi ulke sayisi) yerine A17/F'ye tasindi; F, pasajin notlarinda kisa cevap icin ayrilmis ortam olcumleri paragrafi. Araligin ust ucu soruluyor, alt uc (5.8) rakip deger olarak ayni cumlede duruyor; iki deger de yalnizca bu sahanin o iki haftasina ait.

groups.instructions:
Questions 7-8 refer to Passage A18 - Naming a Species from a Short Piece of DNA

Answer the questions below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answers in boxes 7-8 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: Besides butterflies, which insects were covered by the library the team built?
items.evidence: The method is only as good as that library, and a team working on the butterflies and forester moths of one alpine country built one, then reported what it could not do.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says the team worked on the butterflies and forester moths of one alpine country; the group named alongside butterflies is therefore 'forester moths'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A07 (balina oturum sayisi) yerine A18'e tasindi. Pasajin notlari dokunulmamis birakilabilecek paragraflari A, B, I diye sayiyor; B not tamamlamanin iskeleti oldugu icin kisa cevaba A ve I kaldi, bu kalem A/4'e capali. Genel 'moths' cevabi kabul edilmiyor, ayirt edici sifat zorunlu. 🔴 Baslik eslestirme paketi A paragrafini ornek olarak da kullanmamali.

items.prompt: According to the authors, tissue taken from where can be assigned without a specialist?
items.evidence: Eggs, larvae and broken specimens can be named; tissue from a predator's gut or a bulk trap sample can be assigned without a specialist; and a survey can be rechecked against its vouchers.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says that tissue from a predator's gut, or a bulk trap sample, can be assigned without a specialist; since the question asks where the tissue comes from, the answer is 'a predator's gut'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A08 (deprem oncesi radar goruntusunun tarihi) yerine A18/I'ya tasindi; I, pasajin dokunulmamis birakilabilir dedigi ucuncu paragraf ve hicbir tipin iskeleti degil. Kok 'doku nereden' diye soruyor, ayni cumledeki oteki iki ornek (toplu tuzak ornegi, vocher ile yeniden denetim) rakip olarak duruyor. 🔴 Diger paketler I paragrafina dokunmamali.

groups.instructions:
Questions 9-10 refer to Passage A19 - Turning Salt Water into Drinking Water with Sunlight

Answer the questions below.

Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
Write your answers in boxes 9-10 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: What does each litre of drinking water from the still work out to cost?
items.evidence: The still was built for 150 dollars and, over an assumed working life of ten years, was reckoned to cost 600 dollars in total, which works out at 0.033 dollars for every litre of drinking water it produces.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says the total cost over ten years works out at 0.033 dollars for every litre of drinking water produced; the answer is therefore '0.033 dollars'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A09 (taramali elektron mikroskobu) yerine A19/I'ya tasindi. A19'da diyagram etiketlemenin 10 kalemi duzenek paragraflarini (B-F), tamamlama ailesi ise sonuc paragraflarini (G-H) tuketiyor; geriye maliyet paragrafi I kaliyor. Litre basi maliyet yalniz bu duzenegin kendi hesabindan cikar. 🔴 Not/ozet tamamlama I paragrafina dokunmamali.

items.prompt: After how long was the energy used to make the still's parts judged to have been recovered?
items.evidence: The energy spent in manufacturing the parts was judged to be recovered after 0.88 years of operation, and the best case was given a sustainability index of 1.27.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says the energy spent in manufacturing the parts was judged to be recovered after 0.88 years of operation; the answer is therefore '0.88 years'.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem A12 (30 dakikalik bulmaca oyunu) yerine A19/I'ya tasindi. Ayni paragrafta ama ayri kanit cumlesinde (kanit cumlesi basina en cok 1 soru kurali korundu); ayni cumledeki surdurulebilirlik indeksi (1.27) rakip deger olarak birakildi.
